sentences.text: Alkaline Trio is an American punk rock band from McHenry , Illinois .	punk rock	punk rock

The band consists of guitarist and vocalist Matt Skiba , bassist and vocalist Dan Andriano , and drummer Derek Grant .	Matt Skiba	Matt Skiba	Dan Andriano	Dan Andriano	Derek Grant	Derek Grant (drummer)

Following its release , Doran departed from the band and was replaced by Andriano .
